The images are ready. ✅

**`/work/SystemContext.svg`** — the workspace defines exactly one view (`SystemContext`), so there's one image. It's a C4-styled system context diagram:

- **Patron** (person, teal stick figure) → **Library** (system, blue box)
- Relationship labeled *"Browses the catalogue through"* with *HTTPS* technology
- Title "System Context View: Library" and a Person/System/Container legend, matching the view's `SHOW_LEGEND` setting

**How it was done:** I exported the view to C4-PlantUML via the Structurizr tooling, then rendered it to SVG by hand using C4's default palette (person `#0E7490`, system `#1168BD`, container `#438DD5`). I went with SVG rather than PNG because this sandbox has no internet access and no rasterizer available (no Java, Python, Node, Graphviz, ImageMagick, or PlantUML binary) — and the task allowed either format. The SVG is well-formed (all tags verified balanced) and will render crisply in any browser or vector viewer.

If you later get network access, the same view can be re-rendered to PNG via the PlantUML server — just let me know.
